UserMetric.title: User Registration & Activity Metric
UserMetric.description: Tracks an authenticated user's registration timestamp and latest activity date for real-time admin analytics.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user

lastActiveDate.description: UTC date key YYYY-MM-DD of latest activity

lastActiveAt.description: Server timestamp of latest activity heartbeat

DailyActiveUserEntry.title: Daily Active User Entry
DailyActiveUserEntry.description: Non-PII daily presence document per user under a UTC date bucket for real-time DAU counts.

dateKey.description: UTC date string YYYY-MM-DD matching parent document ID

lastSeenAt.description: Server timestamp when user was last seen on this date

AdminRecord.title: Admin Record
AdminRecord.description: Trusted allowlist entry granting admin-only Firestore read/management privileges.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin

grantedBy.description: UID of admin who granted access

grantedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted

/userMetrics/{userId}.description: User registration and activity telemetry documents keyed by Firebase UID.

/dailyActivity/{dateId}/users/{userId}.description: Per-day active user presence records keyed by YYYY-MM-DD and Firebase UID.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Admin role directory checked by Firestore security rules.
